LOYALTY AND GOLD SCHEMES

Two different things, on one customer.

A gold scheme is the customer’s own money, saved towards a purchase. Loyalty is your reward for coming back. A customer can have both on the same record, and use a scheme balance and loyalty points on the same bill. Scheme members can earn loyalty points too, if you choose.

More questions jewellers ask.

What does Jwero’s jewellery loyalty program software do?

Jewellery loyalty programme software: points and tiers, redemption limited to making charges, anniversary and birthday rewards, referrals, coupons and gift vouchers, at the counter, online and on WhatsApp. It is part of Jwero One, the single plan with every module included. You start with a free trial, and your price is shown in your account when it ends.

How do I run coupons and gift vouchers in a jewellery shop?

Create a coupon with its value, validity and conditions, send it to a segment, and redeem it at the counter or online. Each redemption is recorded against the customer and the campaign.

How do I run a loyalty programme in a jewellery shop?

Define tiers and how points are earned and redeemed, for purchases, referrals and visits. The balance shows on the customer’s record at the counter, so staff can mention it while she is deciding.

What is a jewellery loyalty programme?

A way to reward customers for coming back: points on purchases, tiers with better rewards, anniversary and birthday rewards, referral bonuses, and coupons or gift vouchers, all on the customer’s record and redeemable at the counter, online or on WhatsApp.

How can a jeweller reward points without hurting gold margins?

Set earning rates by category and limit redemption to making charges, so points come off the part of the bill where your margin is, not the gold value. Jwero supports this.

Do loyalty points expire?

Yes, after the period you set. Customers get a reminder before points expire, and points outstanding are tracked as a liability.

How do anniversary rewards work?

Jwero sends a reward a few days before each customer’s anniversary, on WhatsApp, which is often the moment they plan a purchase.

Is loyalty the same as a gold scheme?

No. A scheme is the customer’s money saved towards a purchase; loyalty is your reward for coming back. A customer can have both on the same record, and both can be used on one bill.

Can customers earn points for following or commenting on social media?

Yes. You can give points for comments, follows, likes and shares on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other channels, matched to the customer’s record, so engagement online turns into a reason to visit.

How does referral tracking work?

A customer refers a friend; when the friend buys, the referrer gets the reward you set, and the link between them stays on both records.

Can we tell if the programme pays for itself?

Yes. Repeat visits and sales by tier, points earned and redeemed, and points outstanding show what the programme costs and what it brings back.

How does a customer move up a tier?

By the rule you set, such as spend in a year or number of purchases. The tier and its rewards change automatically, and staff see it at the counter.
